name: Timed Macro
description: Load a .gdr/.gdr2 macro. Each macro jump has a timer window: click inside it and the macro performs the jump for you.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the timed macro assist on or off.

window-seconds.name: Click window (seconds)
window-seconds.description: How long before each macro jump you are allowed to click to trigger it.
